context.title: Coalition on Homelessness: positions from signed ballot arguments, 2026-11-03 California general election

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition A (Charter Changes Affecting Various City Departments and Commissions)

positions.statement: Coalition on Homelessness signed the rebuttal to the argument in favor of San Francisco Proposition A and the argument against San Francisco Proposition A in the San Francisco Voter Information Pamphlet.

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition I (Changes to Real Property Transfer Tax)

positions.statement: Coalition on Homelessness signed the paid argument in favor of San Francisco Proposition I in the San Francisco Voter Information Pamphlet.
